'''Melik Galerha''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] who served as a [[Jedi Knight]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="ROTS" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]].</ref> Galerha attended a briefing on the Republic's [[Outer Rim Sieges]] given by [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in one of the [[Jedi Temple communication center|conference rooms]] of the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="ROTS" />

After the briefing, Galerha left the room while conversing with<ref name="ROTS" /> Jedi Master [[J'oopi Shé]],<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> passing Kenobi's former [[Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker]], as he entered the briefing room.<ref name="ROTS" /> Galerha had dark skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and black [[hair]].<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> The Knight wore brown [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]] and brown [[boot]]s while on Coruscant and carried a [[lightsaber]].<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Melik Galerha first appeared in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" /> The briefing room scene was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[August 8]], [[2003]].<ref name="Archive">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> The [[Melik Galerha/Legends|name]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|314|Galerha, Melik}}</ref>
